items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She‘s got a lot of character in her voice. She‘s good, Moesha.

ctx.x: She‘s funny, too. She‘s a comedian.
Yes, and a grown-up voice for such a little girl. She‘s got a lot of character in her voice. She‘s good, Moesha. That‘s some kind of name, Moesha.
From the seventies Black Power name. [laughs]
